articleTitle: Efficient Indian Sign Language Interpreter For Hearing Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Indian Sign Language (ISL) is the principal mode of communication for most dumb and deaf citizens nationwide. ISL uses signs of movements of the hands, faces, or body postures to transmit the needed message and emotion. These signs may be read by those that are unaware of ISL. It is a fully developed natural language that has its lexicon as well as its syntax. Translation systems are essential to eliminate the communication barrier between the community of deaf and hard-of-hearing people. To facilitate effective two-way communication between the hearing-impaired and the general population of society, the proposed system is an end-to-end human interface architecture capable of recognizing and understanding spoken language and performing the necessary decoding of ISL signals. Results show that the proposed system performs well in recognizing Indian sign language.

articleTitle: Rural Automatic Healthcare Dispatch with Real-Time Remote Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Due to the drastically expanding use of the Internet of Things, remote monitoring of health data to provide intelligent healthcare has recently attracted much interest within the system. Health Chain is a massively-scale, blockchain-based privacy-preserving system for health data that uses encryption to provide fine-grained access control. The 24/7 Medical Counter is used in all rural areas when people have limited options to get in touch with an authorized medical professional. The proposed system is also connected to a camera, a headphone, an ultrasonic sensor, and a load cell. Additionally, set up a heart rate and temperature monitor. Utilized the medical counter and monitored from a distance. Both ends have a program installed that enables voice connection and doctor chat. Medication dispatchers provide medicine from Anytime Medical Machine (AMM) to users as doctors examine patients and write prescriptions. In order for the user to receive the precise time, they might make a request to the server.

articleTitle: Route Stability with Node Reliability-Based Auto Reconfiguration in Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Wireless Mesh Network (WMN) is envisioned as an efficiently feasible paradigm and a capable method for sustaining Quality of Service (QoS). During data transmission, multi-hop WMNs incident repetitive link failures due to many reasons. Hence, these failures originate harsh function degradation in WMNs. This approach presents Route Stability with Node Reliability-based auto-reconfiguration (RSNR) in WMN. Providing reliability is measured to be a demanding job because of the imperfect energy and memory. This approach regulates the radios in the WMN conditional on signal strength to ensure reliability by applying self-reconfiguration. The stability of the path builds the route an applicable one to forward information. The node reliability and the link stability measure the link quality. This link quality node makes self-reconfiguration. The node with a lesser SINR value with the best Link quality node is chosen as the next node. The RSNR approach results revealed increased efficiency of the received rate and residual energy of the packet received rate.

articleTitle: Real-time Monitoring of Women's Safety Through Bluetooth Low Energy and iBeacons
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper presents real-time monitoring of women's safety, which uses Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and iBeacons to provide real-time tracking. Data on the iBeacons' Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) is gathered from BLE-enabled calibration devices. Users' real RSSIs are estimated using the refined least squares estimation method. The predicted RSSI data are used with the Android Application Package (APK) to transmit the precise GPS coordinates of the mobile device to the server. When combined with the APK, the proposed tracking method provides accurate data regarding device position and iBeacon distance. In addition, Google Maps can be incorporated with the system for even more precise real-time monitoring. This system can follow a destination in real time, identify its location, and work with various desktop and mobile platforms. While initially designed to improve women's safety, it can be easily adapted to monitor people's location in multiple settings. Accurate tracking and distance estimates are achieved by integrating wearable BLE-enabled devices, mobile phones, server connectivity, and exact RSSI measurement. Google Maps' incorporation into real-time surveillance enhances women's and other people's safety and security.

articleTitle: Managing E-Reviews: A Performance Enhancement Technique Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: E-business has converted the entire world into a global market where client feedback plays a substantial role in improving the business's productivity as it helps the companies to meet the public demands. Reviews on the products' services helps in knowing the public requirements. Consumer reviews help the business owner to know the success of the product, consequently, the growth of the business as well as the future of the business. Various techniques had emerged in order to gather consumer responses. Sentiment analysis targets to garner the responses and categorize those reviews into some fixed patterns, for example- positive, negative or neutral. This methodology helps to study a large amount of data effectively, efficiently and quickly. This study aims to propose a system that accurately integrates text-based feedback into the thumbs up, thumbs down or non-partisan set. The proffered approach uses deep learning for sentimental analysis to figure out the text and convert it into valuable feedback. The proposed study incorporates a machine learning procedure called the TextEmbedNet Model, which incorporates word embedding, global average pooling, and Dense layers. The performance of the proposed work is measured using F1 Score, Precision, Recall and Specificity constraints. In order to produce the results dataset from Amazon has been taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Deep fake Video Detection Using Unsupervised Learning Models: Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The recent decade has been the most emerging for technical advancements in computer and communication fields. These advancements have made the task of automation much cheaper and available to every other individual at minimum or free of cost. Deep Fakes are one such advancement in the field of image processing. Deep fakes are images or videos developed using deep learning models to create fake images or videos. Although there are advantages of these deep fakes like visual training, powerful simulation, etc... There are also demerits or disadvantages highly possible with these technological advancements such as creating content that never existed, making a person speak something which one has not spoken at all. These mentioned possibilities lead to person identification theft, spreading of false or misinformation, etc... This paper is an attempt to investigate the proposed detection techniques for deep fakes. It focuses on unsupervised deep fake detection techniques and the role of ensemble models for detection.

articleTitle: The Smart Factory of Tomorrow: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Reshaping Manufacturing Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The smart factory of the future would not be possible without the development of AI and ML technologies, which have ushered in a new era of production. Traditional industrial processes are being revolutionized by AI and ML due to their capacity to evaluate large quantities of data and make autonomous choices, which is leading to greater efficiency, productivity, and profitability. Predictive maintenance is one area where AI and ML are making important contributions. These systems may prevent unexpected and expensive failures by constantly monitoring equipment performance and analyzing real-time data. Taking preventative measures like these results in less downtime, lower maintenance expenses, and more efficient machinery. Synergies between AI and ML are improving factory quality assurance. These technologies can identify even the smallest flaws or deviations from product standards using sophisticated vision systems and pattern recognition algorithms. Manufacturing companies may reduce waste and customer complaints by maintaining a constant quality standard via the use of automated inspection methods. Optimization of production planning and scheduling is another important use of AI and ML in manufacturing.

articleTitle: Investing Novel Interaction Techniques Using DeepNets To Improve User Engagement and Usability In Human-Computer Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Human-computer interfaces (HCIs) play a critical role in facilitating user engagement and usability in various domains. Traditional interaction techniques have been widely used, but they often have limitations in terms of user experience and overall effectiveness. In recent years, deep neural networks (DeepNets) have emerged as a powerful tool for modeling complex patterns and relationships in data. This paper presents a novel framework that leverages deep neural networks to develop interaction techniques that enhance user engagement and usability in HCIs. The proposed framework enables real-time adaptation of the interface based on user behavior and preferences, resulting in a more personalized and context-aware user experience. To evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed framework, we conducted a user study comparing the novel interaction techniques with traditional approaches. The results demonstrate that the DeepNet-based interaction techniques significantly improve user engagement and usability metrics, including task completion time, error rate, and user satisfaction. Moreover, qualitative feedback from participants indicates a higher level of immersion, enjoyment, and ease of use with the DeepNet-based techniques. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework and highlight the potential for further advancements in HCI design using deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Based Hybrid Energy Storage System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have received a lot of attention in energy storage systems (ESSs). High power generation and applications for EVs both use hybrid renewable energy. The hybrid source, which includes a power supply with batteries and super capacitors, produces energy without any pollutants. The suggested bidirectional converter combines boost and buck operations, which minimizes voltage stress, simplifies the circuit, increases system performance, and lowers the cost of the system. The battery supplies the energy source to the connected motor load, which is used for EV applications. While peak discharging conditions, the battery life is affected due to the sudden increase in acceleration's impact on peak power consumption. The super capacitor-based backup energy storage system plays a part in overcoming this limitation. In order to maintain power between the source, battery, and load, a PI controller has been suggested to generate pulses for the converter switches. The Internet of Things (IoT) is very important for monitoring and controlling, and it also makes it possible to remotely log data for battery characteristics, conditions, etc. This paper enhances the ESS performance of EVs by reducing energy loss and monitoring the battery parameters using IoT to increase the battery life span.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of the Intrusion Detection System in the Detection of DoS attack using Ada boosting and comparison with SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The goal of this research is to create a cutting-edge IDS that uses Ada Boosting (Group 2) and then compare it to a Support Vector Machine. (Group 1). The research incorporates two algorithms for two IDS groups namely Ada Boosting and SVM. There are 19 samples in each of two groups, for a total of 38 used in the analysis. SPSS was utilised for the statistical analysis. Using G power and a pretest power of 80%, the sample size was determined. The results show that the IDSs work well, with a significance level of p 0.05. Innovative Intrusion Detection System with Ada Boosting dramatically increases IDS accuracy with increasing percentages, and this improvement is statistically significant at the 0.0, or p 0.05 level. The Mean accuracy of Ada Boosting for (Group 2) is 0.994 and with SVM (Group 1) is 0.985. By comparing the performance of the Ada Boosting based IDS and SVM based IDS, Ada boosting based IDS significantly perform better.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Scoring Algorithm for English Translation Based on DNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: With the popularity of languages and the increasing demand for language translation, the optimization of artificial intelligence scoring algorithm for English translation has become the urgent need of the translation market. Based on the deep neural network(DNN) algorithm, it continuously integrates modern technology to realize information collection, storage, analysis and application, which promotes the deep integration of the DNN algorithm in the field of intelligent identification and expands the application scope of artificial intelligence identification technology. This paper focuses on how to efficiently optimize the model of English translation artificial intelligence scoring algorithm by DNN, specifically studying the DNN model, by studying the mathematical model and algorithm flow of the DNN optimization algorithm, and the basic principle of the DNN model; Based on the DNN model, a learning ability analysis model of English translation algorithm is proposed. Experiments show that this model can optimize the artificial intelligence scoring algorithm of English translation.

articleTitle: Anticipating Surface Roughness in Inconel Turning: Harnessing the Power of Neural Networks and Bayesian Regularization
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In recent years, hybrid machining techniques have gained popularity in processing materials that are notoriously tough to work with. This is due to the inherent benefits that hybrid machining techniques hold over individual machining methods. These operations need the coordinated use of a wide variety of machining equipment in a variety of configurations. This research uses a neural network-based Bayesian regularisation technique to investigate the possibility of transforming the problematic material Inconel into a superalloy. The depth of cut, spindle speed, and feed rate are the control elements examined in this study. The performance metric is the primary focus of the average surface roughness (Ra). The experimental testing and the coefficient of determination were used to evaluate the capabilities of the suggested neural network in modeling and forecasting. The findings indicate that there is only a 1.25 percent discrepancy, on average, between the predictions made by neural network-based modeling and the values that were obtained. The surface roughness (Ra) values discovered in the experimental data are identical to those predicted by these equations.

articleTitle: Threat Detection And Mitigation In Self-Organizing Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Self-organizing networks (SON) have emerged as a promising approach for managing and optimizing the performance of modern wireless networks. However, the dynamic and autonomous nature of SON also introduces security vulnerabilities and risks, making effective threat detection and mitigation crucial for ensuring the integrity and resilience of the network infrastructure. This research aims to investigate advanced techniques for threat detection and mitigation in SON networks. The study focuses on developing intelligent algorithms and mechanisms that can proactively identify and respond to various security threats, such as malware, denial-of-service (DoS) attacks, and intrusion attempts. The research also explores the integration of machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of threat detection in real-time SON environments. Furthermore, the study aims to propose effective countermeasures and mitigation strategies that can be deployed within the SON framework to minimize the impact of security threats and maintain the overall network performance. The outcomes of this research will contribute to enhancing the security posture of self-organizing networks, ensuring the reliable and secure operation of wireless infrastructures in the face of evolving cybersecurity challenges.

articleTitle: Development of Primary School Mathematics Education Technology Resources based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: India's compulsory primary education emphasizes mathematics. Math helps boost students' logical and rational thinking. It supports our nation's scientific development and modern students' scientific and cultural growth. Students learn elementary school mathematics by facing a lot of data, thinking, and checking results. Teaching materials are not the only educational technology in the primary school mathematics teaching reform. Math teachers have started to focus on the need for more teaching resources and new tools and technology. Due to the lack of complete and systematic teaching materials, primary school mathematics technical resource development has new goals and requirements. Resource mining with fuzzy clustering is great. Fuzzy clustering algorithm can introduce fuzzy mathematics into cluster analysis, use membership function clustering to determine sample affinity, and analyze and aggregate a large number of text resource information into meaningful classes or clusters for primary school mathematics education technology resource mining and development. An optimization strategy for cluster number is given to meet classic fuzzy clustering algorithm initialization requirements. The optimized fuzzy clustering algorithm optimizes the initial clustering center, overcoming its sensitivity to the beginning value. Thus, the data set is fuzzy-divided unsupervised. This article analyzes created resources to inform primary school campus mathematics education development.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network on Revolutionizing Multimedia Systems and Empowering User Experience With Dynamic Content Delivery
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid growth of multimedia content and the increasing demand for personalized user experiences have fueled the need for innovative approaches to enhance content delivery and design in multimedia systems. In this paper, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) revolutionize multimedia systems, enabling dynamic content delivery and interactive design to empower user experiences. By leveraging their ability to capture sequential patterns, RNNs facilitate the analysis, understanding, and generation of dynamic multimedia content. By learning from user interactions and preferences, RNN models can effectively deliver tailored content recommendations, enhancing user engagement and satisfaction. Through the use of techniques like recurrent generative models, RNNs can generate novel and realistic multimedia content, including images, videos, and audio. Furthermore, RNNs enable interactive design in multimedia systems. By incorporating user feedback and interactions, RNN-based models can adapt and dynamically adjust the content delivery and design, providing an immersive and personalized experience for users. In conclusion, a transformative impact of RNN on multimedia systems, revolutionizing content delivery, and empowering user experiences. By leveraging RNNs, the multimedia systems can adapt and evolve to meet the growing demands of users, ushering in a new era of immersive and engaging multimedia experiences.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Plant Disease Detection for Agricultural Applications: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The agriculture sector plays a major role in supplying high-quality food and makes the biggest contribution to growing economies and people. Plant ailments have the power to drastically limit food production and eliminate species diversity. Early identification of plant diseases using accurate or automatic detection techniques can increase the quality of food output and decrease financial losses. In recent years, deep learning has considerably improved the identification precision of image classification and object detection systems. The development of agricultural products is crucial for the economy of the country. Farmers have a wide range of alternatives for the production of numerous goods. However, plant diseases can impair any agricultural product. Information technology advancements can be utilised to quickly identify and locate agricultural illnesses. Plant diseases must be categorised in order to evaluate agricultural output, increase market value, and maintain quality standards. Despite the fact that many eminent researchers have contributed their suggestions for developing such systems, there are several shortcomings in the recommended and developed systems. The paper provides in-depth discussions on plant illnesses, disease detection systems, and disease classification using image acquisition, image pre-processing, picture segmentation, feature extraction, and classification.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of DQN, DDQN and Dueling DQN in Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Heart disease remains a significant global health concern, it is necessary to develop highly accurate diagnostic system. In recent years, reinforcement learning algorithms have gained attention in addressing medical classification problem. The proposed system is a comparative study of three deep reinforcement learning algorithms, namely Deep Q-Network (DQN), Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) and Dueling Deep Q-Network, for the classification of heart disease. We examined the efficiency of the proposed system using the dataset of patient information and compare their accuracy, speed and ability.This includes the multi agent model for disease classification and it is widely used in robotics, economics and telecommunication. Our findings shows the effectiveness of deep reinforcement learning approaches with multi agent in heart disease classification.

articleTitle: An Optimized Round Robin Central Processing Unit Scheduling Algorithm with Dynamic Time Quantum
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Traffic signals ensure safe driving and regulated flow of traffic at road intersections. With increasing number of cars on the roads, it has become very essential to regulate traffic so that mobility of people residing in Oman is much smoother. Controlling road traffic has been a very challenging task especially at the intersections. Conventionally traffic signal control systems are scheduled in such a way that the vehicles at an intersection move in a fixed pre-timed slot manner. This fixed pre-timed controller approach fails to minimize the waiting time of vehicles at the traffic intersections as it does not sense the queue size of vehicles at the traffic signal. Many a times the traffic flow is not uniform, sometimes traffic is more from a particular direction or probably an accident has occurred in that lane which leads to increasing size of the queue and also the waiting time for people in that lane of intersecting road. In such cases it is often seen The Royal Oman Police (ROP) taking over the traffic signals and controlling the flow of traffic for smooth flow of traffic. To overcome this problem an adaptive and intelligent traffic signal control system is proposed in such a way that a traffic signal controller is installed with a wireless sensor which works on the basis of checking the queue size of vehicles in a particular lane and switches to green or stays in green for longer duration for that lane. It also sends an alert to the telecom companies and the radio channels in Oman to inform the slow moving traffic news to the people of Oman.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm of Road and Bridge Engineering Construction Management Based on Ant Colony Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Highway bridge construction involves many links, with relatively large investment and high-quality requirements, which requires that the on-site construction management should be done well, and the whole project must be done well on the premise of ensuring quality. The quality of on-site construction management of highway and bridge projects directly affects the quality and later use of the whole highway and bridge project. In this paper, ant colony algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of neural network, and a parameter feature fusion model based on ant colony neural network is proposed, and the corresponding program is developed by using the network toolbox. The prediction results show that the maximum relative error of the improved ant colony algorithm test results is 1.22%, and the standard deviation of the relative error is 0.72%, indicating that the model has strong learning ability. Strong robustness, high prediction accuracy and fast speed. very good Therefore, this paper provides a new research idea for highway bridge construction management

articleTitle: Fostering Sustainable Poultry Farming: Chicken Disease Classification through Ensemble Techniques and Local Attention-Based Fused Descriptor Definition
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Chicken disease classification assumes a vital role in maintaining the health and productivity of poultry farms. By accurately identifying diseases through automated image analysis, the poultry industry can take prompt preventive measures, reduce economic losses, and improve flock management practices. This approach offers a cost-effective solution for the pharmaceutical industry by reducing the need for expensive manual diagnosis and enabling targeted drug development, ultimately increasing sales revenue. Deep learning-based feature extraction plays a crucial role in chicken disease classification from poultry fecal images. By employing advanced techniques such as vision transformers and EfficientNet-B0-B0, intricate features can be extracted from the images, allowing for more accurate disease classification. To the best of our knowledge, none of the previous work has evaluated vision transformer in capturing global contextual information for chicken disease classification from fecal images. On the other hand, EfficientNet-B0-B0 offers efficient and scalable feature extraction. Therefore, both the techniques are vital for analyzing complex patterns within the images. Hence, the work has explored early and late ensembling techniques to investigate feature generalization as well as decision fusion of diverse classifiers for enhanced precision in classification results of the chicken diseases. The classification process is carried out using classical algorithms viz, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression(LR) and Random Forest(RF) instead of transfer learning since traditional classifiers offer greater flexibility in evaluating tailored approaches like feature fusion and decision fusion. The late ensembling with classifier decision fusion has outclassed all the other classification techniques in efficiently identifying chicken diseases from fecal images.

articleTitle: User centric AI-based similar defect recommendation system
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Software defect is unwanted but unavoidable side product of software development process. Managing the defect from origin to fix is long cycle and consume lot of effort. Resolving the defect is one of crucial task in the software defect lifecycle. There are many defects which have been fixed in past can give hint for resolving the new defect. However, it is very tedious task to keep track of all the defects in system and get a list of similar or technically duplicate defect. In this paper, we have explained our novel work of retrieving lexically and technically similar defect based on user’s focus. We have leveraged technique of Natural language processing (NLP) to analyze the historical defects in the system and build a model to retrieve similar defects. We have taken user-centric approach to develop the software. This work also opens various possibilities for further research and apply AI on software defects to improve the process of software development overall.

articleTitle: Opportunity-Constrained Programming Model and Algorithm of Enterprise Risk
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: With the rapid development of economic globalization, the "win-win" business model has become the best choice for modern enterprises to adapt to the competitive environment. At first, the enterprise predicted the future sales volume according to the past sales data, made a good production plan, and then mass-produced by MTS, but doing so would either lead to a large increase in inventory or lead to a shortage of goods and lower customer service level; Later, MTO mode of production was gradually accepted by enterprises, but this was at the expense of economies of scale in production and distribution. Agile supply chain is favored for its high efficiency and agility, but because of its higher complexity and unpredictability, its demand risk greatly increases. In this case, the delay strategy came into being. The purpose of implementing the delay strategy is actually to combine these two production methods and divide the whole production process into general production stage and personalized production stage. The unpredictable market environment leads to the increasing uncertainty faced by enterprises. Paying attention to risk and managing risk has become an urgent need for modern enterprise management. Modern enterprises must pay attention to risk management and improve their ability to resist risks. Risk management plays an increasingly important role in the survival and development of enterprises. This paper presents an opportunity-constrained programming model of enterprise risk management based on delay strategy, in which the random factors in enterprise risk are described as random variables. Specifically, the model is an opportunity-constrained programming model, which can better describe the risk preference of managers.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Electric Pneumatic Combined Braking Control for Urban Rail Transit Trains
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The braking control system is a key component of metro vehicles, and the braking capacity of metro is the fundamental guarantee of metro operation safety and transportation capacity. Due to the characteristics of frequent starting and stopping, short station spacing and large passenger capacity change during the subway operation, the subway braking system is required to have higher performance, quality and sensitivity. But the brake system is highly integrated and complex in structure, so it is very difficult to develop, design and experiment teaching. In order to solve the above problems, an experimental system that can simulate the braking process of metro vehicles is developed by combining software and hardware. With the rapid development of rail transit, the requirements for train traction system and braking system are becoming higher and higher. In order to develop a high-performance traction and braking control system, on the premise of in-depth analysis of the functions and operation modes of the electric traction and electric air combined braking test platform, the construction methods of the AC, DC and AC electric traction test platform and the electric air combined braking test platform which are fed with each other at the AC side and used for different driving modes are proposed. And put forward the specific operation control mode of the development test platform.

articleTitle: The Rise of Smart Retail: Analysing the Technological Shifts in Singapore's E-commerce Landscape due to COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Rise of Smart Retail and Online changes of consumers in Singapore, being the Head Quarters of most of the multinational corporations need to analyse, as such changes are possible to be seen in the other countries soon. The major concepts that are involved in this study are consumer attitude and online shopping. Considered relevant to this research on digitalization, the factors that affect online shopping behaviour, online shopping behaviour business model and impact of COVID-19 are studied. This research is grounded on realism, a philosophy based on the principles of positivist and interpretivist research philosophies and ideas crucial to the understanding of the idiosyncrasies of human nature, focusing on reality and the beliefs present in an environment. Research highlights that businesses can provide better products and render better services to existing customers and attract new ones. Since the results suggest there is an increased opportunity online, those who do not have a digital presence yet should consider entering ecommerce, as communication and computing are changing due to COVID-19.

articleTitle: Design of Mes System for Discrete Manufacturing Based on Rfid Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: RFID technology, different communication methods, and the idea of layered design are employed in order to accommodate the features of the discrete manufacturing business. These characteristics include the presence of multiple types, tiny batches, rapid process modifications, and a significant deal of difficulty in the application of information. At the same time, the discrete manufacturing MES system that was developed by combining multithreading synchronization technology and a database aided design program is able to complete the tracking of discrete manufacturing work in progress, product quality traceability, workshop on-site real-time data collection, reasonable control of workshop production plan, enterprise equipment and personnel monitoring at any time, and real-time process feedback correction. Investigation is being done towards a different approach to the acquisition and processing of data for workshop production. throughout the same time, the configuration type secondary development mode is implemented throughout the process of putting the system into operation. This helps to improve the effectiveness of the software development process.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Hybrid Methodology for Intelligent Bin Monitoring and Optimization in Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Effective waste management is crucial for sustainable and eco-friendly cities. The study proposed a hybrid optimization approach which combines Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) and Harmony Search (HS) algorithms to optimize waste collection routes and enhance operational efficiency in sustainable cities. Real-world data platforms such as waste data flow and eurostat were used to evaluate the method by demonstrating its effectiveness in optimizing routes, reducing costs and improving resource allocation with an average accuracy rate of 92.5%. The integration of ACO and HS algorithms enabled waste management authorities to minimize travel distances and enhance operational processes by contributing to improved efficiency and cost reduction. The study also emphasized the potential for further enhancements through the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) devices and real-time data through which offering a practical and efficient solution for waste management optimization and promoting environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ideological and Political Pedagogy System Based on Service-Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: According to the requirements of intellectualization in the current ideological and political course teaching process, based on the full analysis of the specific needs and objectives of ideological and political mobile teaching, this paper develops an ideological and political pedagogy system based on SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture). Realize the mobile learning of ideological and political course, and elaborate the system's design framework and implementation process in detail. The actual test shows that the system runs stably and performs well, and can effectively promote the ideological and political pedagogy activities, improve the enthusiasm of teachers and students, provide an effective solution for the intellectualization and multimedia of ideological and political pedagogy, and has strong practical and reference value.

articleTitle: Workforce Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Today, businesses and organizations around the world are keeping up with the ever-changing and developing technology breakthroughs. In the last few years, data science has been used to make educated, smart decisions and improve business performance. An organization's workforce is one of its key elements and understanding the workforce goes a long way in advancing the organization's success. This study investigates the effects of employee characteristics, supervisor characteristics, and other job parameters on employee presence in the factory. The analysis was conducted using hypothesis testing methods such as the chi-squared test and analysis of variance and also using machine learning algorithms like multiple linear regression and classification algorithms like K-nearest neighbor, random forest and support vector machine. Gaining insight into the personal characteristics of employees, as well as how these traits, including commitment to work, may be influenced by the traits of their supervisors, provides a valuable means of understanding the complexities of human behavior within workplace dynamics. This enables us to understand how their traits fit their workstyle group.

articleTitle: Simulation of Industrial Economic Development Model Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: As human society enters the era of the knowledge economy, the "industrial economic development of Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm (FCM), which promotes the development of science and technology and social progress, has undergone profound changes in both connotation and form, and has gradually become an important part of the national development strategy." In order to investigate the effects of various policy alternatives on the energy industry, a system simulation model of the expansion of the energy industry from the position of a low-carbon economy is created based on DPSIR theory from the perspectives of energy, economy, environment, policy, and society. There are other clustering algorithms available today, but the fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is the most widely used. Many improved techniques are presented based on this algorithm to produce a better clustering effect. The clustering effectiveness index must be evaluated for the effect after clustering. Clustering analysis is a critical component of unsupervised pattern recognition. Fuzzy clustering has become the industry standard for clustering analysis because it establishes the ambiguous description of the sample for the category and can more precisely reflect reality.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Algorithm in Building Electrical Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern building system towards automation and intelligence, the importance of building electrical system is becoming more and more prominent. Its operation status and reliability directly affect the normal operation of building system. Therefore, research and analysis of the building electrical system fault diagnosis has important value for development of the construction industry. Most building electrical systems are neutral grounding systems, with large fault current. Once grounding or short circuit faults occur, the whole system will lose stability. Therefore, the failure will cause greater harm to the distribution system and electrical equipment. In this paper, the main research object is the failure of the electrical system in the building. Common building electrical faults are simulated by building electrical comprehensive experimental platform. And use low-voltage electrical comprehensive tester to collect fault data. Firstly, a fault diagnosis algorithm for building electrical system based on wavelet analysis and support vector machine algorithm is proposed. At the same time, considering the low efficiency of building electrical system diagnosis, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis algorithm based on compressed sensing and K nearest neighbor algorithm. It aims to improve the efficiency of building electrical system fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis using Machine Learning Techniques for Detecting and Mitigating Phishing
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Phishing is a malicious technique employed by hackers to illicitly obtain confidential user information for their own misuse. In contemporary times, three notable approaches have emerged as effective countermeasures against such attacks: awareness-focused strategies, blacklist-based methods, and machine learning (ML) techniques. Hence, this systematic paper aims to provide researchers, readers, and users with an analysis of diverse proposals from other scholars on how to effectively combat phishing using ML algorithms. The research focuses on phishing detection utilizing ML techniques, establishing a taxonomy of machine learning models by examining their respective advantages and disadvantages. Furthermore, the performance analysis based on the available datasets of the ML classifiers such as NB, SVM, KNN, RF, and ANN is evaluated in terms of the performance metrics and the accuracy values of the classifiers on kfold at 10 is 82.40%, 83.00%, 83.60%, 84.39%, and 84.84%, and TP at 8 is 81.03%, 81.62%, 82.21%, 83.23%, and 83.77%, respectively.

articleTitle: Surface Roughness Prediction in Turning of Super Alloy through the Scaled Conjugate Gradient Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Surface roughness (Ra) is an important quality characteristic in the machining process since it influences the performance and functionality of the machined components. The Scaled Conjugate Gradient (SCG) technique is used in this study to estimate surface roughness during the turning process of Duplex stainless steel. The proposed model incorporates the SCG algorithm and the empirical data obtained from turning tests conducted with duplex stainless steel. The output variable is the value of the surface roughness once it has been measured. The model educates itself on the fundamental link between the input parameters and the surface roughness, then adjusts its weights and biases to achieve the best possible accuracy in its predictions. Statistical metrics such as mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), and coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) are utilized to quantify prediction. The findings indicate that during the turning process, the SCG model can accurately predict the surface roughness of duplex stainless steel. Manufacturers can utilize these predictive skills to optimize machining parameters, attain the desired surface quality, and raise production while reducing costs. In conclusion, this study focuses on using the SCG model for surface roughness prediction during the turning process of duplex stainless steel. The proposed model provides valuable insights for process optimization, enabling manufacturers to improve machining productivity and achieve high-quality surface finishes.

articleTitle: Quantum Machine Learning Approach for Eigen Solving and Fourier Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: When parametrized quantum circuits are viewed as models that translate data inputs into predictions, quantum computers can be utilized for supervised learning. Many crucial theoretical aspects of these models remain unknown, even though considerable work has been done to understand the practical consequences of this method. Quantum models can access richer and richer frequency spectra by repeatedly repeating straightforward data-encoding gates. Since simulation time increases exponentially, simulation-based training cannot be used to big QML models. Variational quantum algorithms and quantum GAN are expected to give the best results if applied for different health care applications in microseconds. The present work explains how QML can be applied for variational quantum eigen solving. This paper also explains quantum Fourier transform analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of RF Heating Uniformity with Cylindrical Electrode Plates and Adding Polypropylene
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The Radio frequency (RF) heating is a treatment for agricultural products instead of chemical methods of disinfection, resulting damage life health and environment. RF heating was used and developed for a long time. The main problems that are non-uniform heat distribution. It is problem that cause cold spot and hot spot contribute to the viability of insects and loss quality of product, respectively. In this study, to improve uniformity heat distribution of rice samples with cylindrical electrode plates and adding polypropylene (PP) in cavity as a new strategy. An applicator simulation models were evaluated temperature distribution uniformity with electric field intensity and power loss density were occurred. An applicator structure consisted of high 50 mm, inner diameter is 40 mm and outer diameter is 160 mm with copper thickness is 0.5 mm. Polypropylene was placed in different positions with cylindrical shape, thickness is 10 mm. A 50 W, 27.12 MHz RF system was used to generate electric field in experiment. The results showed that using cylindrical electrode plates was not occur hot spot but has over heat surround inner conductor. That can be reduce and improved the temperature distribution uniformity with adding PP material.

articleTitle: Routing Protocols in MANET: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: There are many nodes contained inside MANET (Mobile Ad hoc Network). Multi-hop communication is used by these dynamical nodes to communicate among themselves. Such a network does not contain a control system. Because the network's infrastructure is of low quality, these nodes are randomly mobile and free to travel in any direction. The mobile hosts are communicated with each other through wireless links. The network has nodes which are played a role of router and responsible for transmitting the packets among other nodes over the network. Various routing protocols of MANET are reviewed in this work.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management Strategy and Multi-energy Integrated Control of Hybrid Electric Car Considering Regenerative Braking
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The environmental pollution situation that we are currently experiencing is becoming more and more serious as the environmental pressure that we are under continues to increase. As a result of this, the goal of developing new vehicles that have a low displacement has emerged as a very important endeavour in the automotive industry. At the moment, the most popular method utilised by hybrid electric vehicles to recuperate the energy lost during braking is called regenerative braking. It is possible to realise regenerative braking in electric vehicles, hybrid electric vehicles, but not in traditional vehicles. This is one of the most significant differences between these three types of vehicles and traditional vehicles. This paper reveals the performance of braking safety performance and braking energy recovery rate under the regenerative braking control strategy of hybrid electric car. It does so by means of theoretical analysis and simulation research. As a result, it provides reference basis for further improving the performance of regenerative braking system and multi-energy integrated control of hybrid electric car.

articleTitle: Optimization of Livestock Farming Using Multi-Tasking Regularisation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Effective management and monitoring of cow behavior attributes are vital for the success of dairy farming. This study introduces a comprehensive methodology that employs the Multi-Task Regularization (MTR) model to accurately predict three critical cow behavior attributes: activity level, feeding duration and rumination time. By integrating multiple machine learning algorithms within the MTR framework shared representations of input features are harnessed while task-specific output layers are maintained for each behavior attribute. Through rigorous experimentation the MTR model demonstrates superior performance surpassing other machine learning models in terms of accuracy as 89 per cent, 93 per cent and 91 per cent for the behavior attributes, precision and recall values across all behavior attributes. The precise predictions obtained from the MTR model empower farmers to make well-informed decisions pertaining to animal health, welfare and productivity enabling optimized feeding strategies, early identification of health concerns and enhanced herd management. Moreover, the potential integration of the MTR model with advanced monitoring technologies holds promise for comprehensive cow behavior prediction within the domain of dairy farming.

articleTitle: Adaptation of a BERT Model to the India Restaurant data using Rule-based Approach for Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ASBA) concept has been worked extensively as a popular technique in consumer research. The commercial applications though limited are being tested. The research mainly focuses on using the existing ASBA model to be adopted, tested and validated for use in the context of consumer reviews for restaurants in Indian geography. We used the rule-based approach instead of the supervised or unsupervised based machine learning approach to adapt the ABSA model with a hypothesis that the rule-based approach would yield F Square estimates equivalent to supervise or unsupervised learning approach.Our research indicated the rule-based approach was equivalent to the supervised approach of training and presented better F square estimates than the unsupervised approach. However, it required more manpower and effort to build the rule-based adaptation while the adopted model will demand constant revisions and maintenance based on the change in the consumer vocabulary.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Redis, Memcached, MySQL, and PostgreSQL: A Study on Key-Value and Relational Databases
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: This paper investigates and compares the performance of relational databases (MySQL and PostgreSQL) and key-value databases (Memcached and Redis) under various test loads. The study utilizes the Yahoo! Cloud Serving Benchmark to simulate diverse workloads and measure the behavior of these databases in different scenarios. The primary focus is on evaluating run time, throughput, and average latency metrics to understand how each database type handles varying thread levels and workload intensity. The outcomes of this research provide valuable insights into the scalability and efficiency aspects of relational databases. By conducting a comprehensive performance comparison, the study aims to assist database designers and developers in selecting the most suitable database option based on specific requirements. The findings contribute to informed decision-making regarding the choice between key-value and relational databases in various data storage scenarios.

articleTitle: Detection of DDoS attacks on time based features using Stacking ensemble technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: DDoS attacks are now among the most common and costly risks in today’s constantly evolving cyber-security land- scape. A DDoS attack occurs when a large amount of internet traffic is directed at a single server or network in an effort to overwhelm it and disrupt regular operations. According to reports from Cloudfare HTTP DDoS attacks increased by a huge percentage of 111% from 2021 to 2022. In fact, current studies and statistics predict that in 2023, the number of DDOS attacks will rise by nearly 300%. This poses a substantial risk to both corporations and individuals because these assaults have the potential to seriously harm websites that are tied to both. A defense mechanism for DDoS has become crucial for key enterprises and government organizations due to their capacity to interrupt network services and cause damages. Previously related work established that shallow and deep learning classifiers were highly useful and detecting and classifying DDoS attacks. Despite this, there hasn’t been much research on the The time-based characteristics and classification of the various DDoS assault kinds. As a result, the proposed model examines the efficiency using time-based criteria in recognising and categorising different DDoS attack types with stacking ensemble technique combining various models for the best accuracy in order to detect the DDoS attack.

articleTitle: Design of Financing Strategy Model of Financial Management Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: With the continuous development of India's market economy, the competition between enterprises is becoming increasingly fierce. In order to better deal with the fierce market competition, enterprise managers begin to pay more attention to internal management. Compared with traditional financial analysis methods, data mining technology can deeply understand the potential and deep-seated information of massive financial data, assist the company's financial analysts, investors and decision-makers to deeply understand the company's financial situation and make correct decisions on relevant problems. The enterprise financial data and non-financial data output by the traditional accounting information system have excess data and insufficient information. In the face of these structured or semi-structured massive data, the data mining technology is applied to the system to fully and effectively predict the future development trend of the enterprise. If enterprises want to achieve better results in the fierce market competition and achieve their own better development at the same time. We should recognize the important role of financial management and financing and data mining technology and apply data mining technology in financial management and financing. As an important part of financial management, fund-raising management is of great significance to the majority of enterprises. On the one hand, financing management is directly related to the financing process of small and medium-sized enterprises and determines the scale and speed of enterprise financing. On the other hand, through rational allocation and fund-raising, enterprises can realize the normal operation of various activities and provide a solid foundation for debt repayment financing. This paper will analyze and study the financial management and financing of enterprises based on data mining technology.

articleTitle: High-Speed Communication in Memory Controller by Novel Pipeline Register Design
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory (SDRAM) can transmit data much quicker than asynchronous RAM. It is very important for data flow; a memory controller with high speed is required. High-performance digital circuits may be designed using an optimization approach called parallel pipeline register architecture. This work proposes a novel pipeline register design for high-speed communication. The structure consists of many stages, each responsible for executing a unique function in concert with the others. The data is saved in the pipeline register while it is being processed in the different phases of the pipeline. The user module and the memory controllers communicate with each other by a rapid memory link connection and data connection. Results show that the FPGA design of the proposed design is possible, and the Xilinx 13.1 ISE simulator's performance show that the proposed design improves the performance of digital circuits with less latency and high throughput.

articleTitle: Minimizing Test cases in Rest API Fuzzing
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Fuzzing, one of the most well-liked methods of software testing, can identify several program flaws by creating numerous tests, such as software flaws and vulnerabilities inputs. Fuzzing is regarded as a useful bug because of its effectiveness in hunting strategy. An Overview of an Implementation of a REST API fuzzer This paper takes an OpenAPI Specification and automatically starts generating test cases based on the endpoints and starts to test the given REST API endpoint. One of the features is that it infers dependencies between the endpoints hence it is stateful and it tries to minimize the number of test cases by checking for consecutive 404s. The test cases that generate random data are done by the Hypothesis Library. This Implementation was tested against the state-of-the-art web API fuzzer RESTler and comparisons are shown.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimization Algorithm for Optimized Path Selection in Mobile Ad hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Mobile Ad-Hoc Network is a transitory network that contains interrelated nodes jointly. The WSN is consisted of ad-hoc networks having least infrastructure and there is not any central controller in it as the nodes are distributed at random. Diverse sets of communicating devices are involved in this network and they are available without any existing framework to connect in an abrupt manner. The network topology is changed rapidly due to the movements of motes over diverse locations at varied speed as there is not any fixed structure. Two schemes namely static and dynamic are utilized to configure this network. This research work is planned on the basis of establishing a path amid source and target. The well-known routing protocols are AODV, DSR and DSDV and a comparative analysis is done on them concerning diverse metrics. This results in enhancing an effective Ad-hoc On-demand Distance Vector protocol routing protocol to establish a route. A hybrid protocol generated on the basis of BCA and ACAs. Network Simulator 2 is executed to compute the suggested approach. The simulation outcomes exhibited that the suggested approach leads to improve the outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Brain Tumor Diagnosis through Multimodal Fusion and 3D Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Brain tumor detection has enhanced using a Multi-CNNs with Multimodal Information Fusion method has been proposed in this work. The proposed method leverages multiple modalities, like T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and FLAIR images, to create a fused representation of the input data. A deep neural network architecture using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3D-CNNs) is constructed to capture spatial and volumetric information present in medical images. The method also incorporates a real normalization layer and a weighted loss function to improve the learning process and prioritize accurate detection and localization of tumor lesions. Evaluating our method on a Kaggle dataset of 253 images (98 without tumor, 155 with tumor), we achieve superior results compared to existing approaches. Our proposed method attains an accuracy of 98.9%, sensitivity of 99.2%, specificity of 99.1%, recall of 98.7%, precision of 99.3%, and F1 score of 98.9%. Leveraging multimodal fusion, 3D-CNNs, and additional enhancements, our study contributes to more reliable brain tumor diagnosis, benefiting patients and healthcare providers.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction Model of Real Estate Price Fluctuation Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The real estate business, being capital-intensive, has a strong interdependence with the economy. Consequently, the stability of the real estate sector has a direct impact on both the economy and finance. The real estate sector has emerged as a significant catalyst for the advancement of India’s overall economic growth. Nevertheless, the inherent instability of the real estate sector renders it susceptible to fluctuations in the broader economic landscape, hence potentially engendering significant repercussions for the financial system and exposing it to various forms of risk. This research introduces a predictive model for assessing the risk of real estate price fluctuations, utilising a neural network method. The findings of this study indicate that, following numerous iterations, the predictive model for real estate price fluctuation risk presented in this research outperforms the conventional GA algorithm. The model achieves a remarkable accuracy rate of 95.71%, surpassing the GA method by 21.44% and reducing the error by 31.73%. Hence, this model possesses the capability to assess the volatility of real estate prices, enabling the implementation of appropriate measures to mitigate and manage economic and financial risks associated with real estate. These measures can be formulated based on the analysis outcomes, thereby proposing preventive actions to address financial risks.

articleTitle: Leveraging Big Data for Precision Medicine Through Infrastructure as-a Service(Iaas): A Case Study in Genomic Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Advancements in precision medicine heavily rely on the analysis of large-scale genomic datasets. However, the increasing size and complexity of genomic data pose significant challenges in terms of resource allocation, scalability and cost-effectiveness. This study addressed the challenges involved in analyzing such datasets for precision medicine and evaluated the feasibility and effectiveness of using Cloud Genomics Infrastructure-as-a-Service (GMaaS) platforms. A dataset consisting of 100 samples with an average size of 50 GB is utilized as a case study. The proposed GMaaS model provides scalable and cost-effective infrastructure provisioning by optimizing the utilization of resources. The results demonstrated improved execution times for each stage of the genomic data analysis pipeline when adopting IaaS. On average data preprocessing, variant calling, functional annotation and downstream analysis take 20, 30, 25 and 40 minutes, respectively. The cost analysis highlighted the cost-effectiveness of GCMaaS which enablies efficient resource allocation. The scalability and flexibility of GCMaaS support collaborative precision medicine research. Cloud-based infrastructure particularly GCMaaS is essential for genomic data analysis in precision medicine.

articleTitle: Hybrid Voltage Compensation Topology based RF Rectifier for RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: In our contemporary context, the development of energy harvesting topology has drawn considerable interest. Due to its accessibility, RF energy harvesting is expected to have a promising future in producing a little amount of electrical power to operate a variety of low power electronics equipment. In order to transform an RF signal into usable electrical power, rectifier circuits with various compensation topologies are presented by different researchers. In this context, hybrid i.e. combination of Self Voltage Compensation and Internal Voltage Compensation is proposed to attain high efficacy than other existing topologies. The circuits are designed and simulated in Cadence Virtuoso Tool with 45nm CMOS technology. It is noted that the output voltage of 2.1V at 500MHz frequency.

articleTitle: IoT-enabled Secure Service-Oriented Architecture (IOT-SOA) through Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Web providers publish service descriptions in a registry for clients to find and use in conventional SOA. This design allows loosely connected service invocation but lacks a dispute resolution mechanism, compromising service calls between untrusted consumers and providers. However, integrating blockchain technology into classic SOA enables a revolutionary trust solution. IoT-enabled Service-Oriented Architecture (IOT-SOA) proposes a blockchain-based verified SOA architecture for IoT device service invocation. During a trusted service call, the consumer securely provides encrypted parameters to the provider in this innovative framework. The service provider expertly decrypts the parameters, conducts the service, and encrypts the output. The service provider methodically develops and stores a trusted credential on the blockchain while sending the encrypted result to the customer. A smart contract for arbitration resolves service-related issues. Experimental results show that, compared to traditional invocations, the proposed method effectively resolves service disputes between service providers and requesters while limiting service invocation growth to 30%. The exceptional IOT-SOA design builds trust by combining blockchain technologies and the SOA framework and leaves trust issues behind as we transform the IoT-enabled SOA model.

articleTitle: Investigating the Role of Smart Learning Spaces and Smart Technology in Student Engagement
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: 'Smart learning' a new vision, revolves around improving learning through digital technology and considering the smart learning spaces. One of the essential features of smart learning is high engagement. This study aims to analyse the role of technology in smart learning spaces to enhance student engagement in the teaching-learning process. Students’ awareness of the engagement and benefits of smart technologies, motivate them to adopt and use technology to enhance their learning. So, this study used the perception of the students of Bachelor in Architecture, an undergraduate program, as a measure to collect the data and analyse whether the students perceive technology as an essential feature of learning spaces to enhance student engagement in learning. This study will help develop smart learning spaces which can support and improve student engagement in learning and finally improve the students' learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Traffic Sampling on Machine Learning Based Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: A Network-based Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) application monitors traffic flow across the network. A NIDS raises an alarm when an attack or a violation is discovered so that the network administrator can respond appropriately. Network intrusion solutions that rely on machine learning functions using flow characteristics obtained through flow exporting protocols. The applicability of machine learning for NIDS systems assumes that such traffic information is gathered from every packet in the flow. However, in actual use, flow exporters are frequently installed on convenient devices like routers, and switch where processing each flow requires certain bandwidth and memory consumption and thus requires a packet sampling technique. Application of such ML-based NIDS solutions where there is uncertainty in the sampling process. Even in the presence of sampling, it can still offer a reliable assessment of NIDS. Through sampling studies, we can observe that even with low sample rates malignant flows of a smaller size are likely to go undetected. The proposed system indicates a procedure to investigate sampling techniques on NIDS. The detection rate is computed for dynamic sampling rates for a simple random sampling approach, Sketchflow sampling, and hybrid sampling approach by evaluated using Random Forest, Decision Tree, and XGBoost machine learning algorithms. The results of the experiments demonstrate that in comparison to other classifiers Random Forest offers a greater detection rate of 99.3% and a lower false alarm rate through the sampling technique.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection Systems for Enhancing Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) that are powered by machine learning have become an important tool for enhancing online security due to their capacity to detect and respond quickly to potential attacks. This is one of the reasons why IDS have grown so popular. In this article, we investigate how machine learning techniques might be applied to the challenge of intrusion detection by making use of the UNSW-NB15 dataset. The dataset, compiled by researchers at the University of New South Wales, includes benign and malicious network activity examples. The dataset known as UNSW-NB15 is utilised throughout this work in order to conduct an in-depth analysis and comparison of a number of different machine learning strategies. These strategies include decision trees, support vector machines (SVM), random forests, and deep learning models. The data collected from the network traffic is first subjected to preprocessing, after which feature engineering methods are utilised to extract the features of interest. In order to evaluate the usefulness of the constructed models, conventional metrics including as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score are utilised. The findings provide evidence that a number of different machine learning algorithms can be used to detect the numerous types of assaults that were represented in the UNSW-NB15 dataset. The study also analyses how different feature engineering strategies affect detection accuracy. Finding the best machine learning algorithms and feature engineering techniques to improve cybersecurity using the UNSW-NB15 dataset is an important outcome of this research that will help to move intrusion detection systems forward. The findings can be used to improve IDS, which helps strengthen the defenses of vital systems and networks against new cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Forecast Algorithm of Financial Time Series Analysis Based on Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The financial system is both transparent and convoluted, with deep connections between the myriad of economic factors that are at play. The contemporary view of finance can be broken down into three distinct components: the time value of money, asset pricing, and risk management. The crux of the issue is finding the appropriate distribution of resources across time periods while operating in an uncertain environment. In the subject of forecasting financial time series, numerous studies have proven that the link between input and output variables is not stable, and that both variables always vary with time. This has been demonstrated by the findings of the studies. Because data comprises a significantly greater amount of information, it is only natural to give more weight to more current information. The study of financial markets now would be incomplete without the inclusion of time series analysis, both as a theoretical framework and a practical methodology. One of the methods that are considered to be part of the mainstream in quantitative financial analysis is the time series analysis method. This study makes use of the Markov model, which is a technique for forecasting financial time series that has been shown to reduce the amount of error associated with forecasting.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-based Relay Selection in Underwater Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: As one of the most challenging and promising wireless communications, underwater communication has received much attention. According to the distance, there may be significant delay, limited bandwidth and attenuation, which reduce the system's overall performance. To solve these problems, Artificial Neural Network based Relay Selection (ANNRS) in Under Water Wireless Sensor Networks (UWSN) is introduced. This mechanism uses the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithm to choose the relay nodes to pass the data from sender to receiver. The ANN algorithm picked out the relay using four input features: Energy, bandwidth, depth and packet received ratio (PRR). The UWSN may dynamically pick the optimum relay node depending on the current network circumstances by employing an ANN-based relay selection system, which improves network performance, lowers energy consumption, and increases data transmission reliability. The extensive simulation outcomes demonstrate that the ANNRS mechanism enhances the performance, such as PRR, and energy, and minimizes the delay and Assemble Propagation Distance in UWSN.

articleTitle: The crucial role of multimedia on Adaptive Network Management- A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: The accessibility of multimedia services, the growth of mobile devices, and the development of relevant video and audio applications have all changed the way users live in recent times. Research groups from industry and academia are facing new problems because of users' needs for multimedia accessibility everywhere, whenever, and from any platform. To cope with such intricate multimedia systems, novel network, application, and user-based technologies should be developed. This review presents the crucial role of multimedia in adaptive network management through a systematic review process. Hence, this paper uses the peer-reviewed published articles from 2001 to 2021 and includes 12 studies based on inclusion and exclusion criteria. The findings of the study state that the role of multimedia in adaptive network management has increased in recent years because of its various advantages.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Covid and Pneumonia Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference On Smart Technologies For Smart Nation (SmartTechCon)
abstract: Internal images of the body may be captured using X-ray technology, which helps doctors diagnose and treat a wide range of medical issues. Recent studies have focused on optimizing the usage of deep learning algorithms to boost medical imaging's accuracy and productivity. Deep learning AI makes use of massive datasets to train computer algorithms to recognize patterns, which are then used to make predictions or classifications about fresh data. This method has shown promise in facilitating quicker and more accurate detection of conditions including lung cancer and bone fractures using X-ray images. Patient outcomes may improve with the use of deep learning algorithms in medical imaging. Healthcare systems may be strengthened, and the effects of health crises lessened by facilitating faster and more accurate diagnosis.
